description: Use when comparing a direct spectral-prediction classifier against a two-stage annotate-then-predict pipeline on the same labeled compounds, and per-strategy recall, precision, F1, and compound-coverage counts are needed.

name: classifier-performance-comparison
description: Use when two MS/MS spectra classification approaches must be compared on the same ground-truth test set, e.g. reproducing the AnnoMe-vs-SIRIUS prenylated flavonoid benchmark from Section 3.2/Table ST2.

name: classifier-performance-metric-computation
description: Use when several classifiers (e.g. DL plus LDA/SVM/RF/RPART/LOG/GBM) have been fitted on the same train/test split of a metabolomics feature matrix and you need comparable accuracy, SEN, SPEC and F1 values to rank them, as in the Lilikoi ER benchmark (accuracy 0.91, SEN 0.95, F1 0.93 for DL).

name: classifier-performance-statistical-comparison
description: Use when several classification algorithms or metric sets have been evaluated over repeated CV runs and a statistically defensible global winner must be chosen from correlated F-measure/Accuracy distributions.

name: classifier-prediction-count-validation
description: Use when an article reports integer counts or fractions of MS/MS spectra classified into a compound class and you must reproduce those tallies from deposited MGF inference spectra plus trained classifiers.

name: classifier-variable-importance-analysis
description: Use when labeled chromatographic peak-quality metrics are available and you need to train a random-forest 'Bad'-peak classifier and rank which quality metrics drive the classification.

name: classroom-compound-list-extraction
description: Use when auditing curation provenance in a community biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) database: the goal is to quantify how many new entries each curation channel contributed and enumerate compounds tied to a specific channel.

name: classyfire-chemical-class-routing
description: Use when predicting ESI-MS/MS spectra for a compound that may belong to a rule-covered class (e.g. acylcarnitines, acylcholines, flavonols, flavones, flavanones, flavonoid glycosides, lipids) and you must decide whether MSRB rule-based prediction applies.

name: classyfire-chemical-classification-mapping
description: Use when an annotated metabolite feature table (with group/module assignments such as WGCNA co-accumulation modules) needs chemical-class labels and per-group ClassyFire term enrichment analysis.

name: classyfire-chemical-taxonomy-assignment
description: Use when a molecule set includes structures (SDF/molfile, InChI, SMILES) or PubChem numbers and you need superclass-level chemical composition percentages, e.g. to characterize dataset coverage or check annotation bias.

name: classyfire-chemotaxonomic-classification
description: Use when MS/MS molecular network nodes carry SMILES (from GNPS library hits, NAP, or DEREPLICATOR) and you need hierarchical chemical class assignments to compare metabolite class distributions across taxa or network components.

name: classyfire-npclassifier-ontology-mapping
description: Use when MS/MS spectra from GNPS molecular networking and BGC products need class annotations in ClassyFire and NPClassifier ontologies to match classes across genome- and metabolome-based mining, e.g. to build NPClassScore scoring tables or filter BGC–MS/MS links.

name: classyfire-ontology-aggregation
description: Use when a GNPS molecular network's nodes carry candidate SMILES annotations (GNPS library hits, NAP, DEREPLICATOR) and you must compute per-family chemical class scores across the ClassyFire ontology hierarchy.

name: classyfire-ontology-batch-classification
description: Use when you have a batch of MSI level 3 structure annotations (e.g. from NIST hybrid search or CSI:FingerID) with InChI keys or formulas and need a chemical-class distribution of the unannotated metabolome.

name: classyfire-superclass-annotation-analysis
description: Use when evaluating formula-prediction accuracy across molecular strata (polarity/LogP, mass, ClassyFire superclass) on tandem MS test predictions to flag underperforming chemical classes.

name: classyfire-superclass-frequency-tabulation
description: Decision support for choosing between CANOPUS and MolNetEnhancer before running chemical class matching (e.g. NPClassScore), or for auditing how much superclass predictions disagree when both tools annotate the same GNPS molecular networking spectra.

name: cli-command-test-verification
description: Use when a package or paper claims a quantitative test-coverage figure (e.g. 'total testing code coverage above 90%') and the claim must be reproduced by running the test suite and measuring coverage per module.

name: clinical-metabolomics-data-processing
description: Use when a clinical metabolomics/lipidomics feature matrix has matched patient metadata (e.g. age, BMI, sex, tumor stage, tissue, repeated measures) and subject-specific variation must be minimized before multivariate modeling or feature selection.

name: clinical-metabolomics-dataset-curation
description: Use when a task requires combining aggregate statistics (p-value, fold-change) from multiple clinical metabolomics studies where compound names differ across sources and per-study raw data are unavailable.

name: clinical-metadata-association-summarization
description: Use when MOFA factor values and a clinical metadata table (numeric and binary patient features) are available and the goal is to rank discriminant MOFA factors by their statistical association with clinical traits.

name: clinical-outcome-prediction-from-serum-metabolomics
description: Use when you have a serum metabolomics feature matrix (mzLearn-derived MS1 peaks, e.g. 2,736 features) with clinical labels (IMDC class, OS time/event) and need to predict treatment response or survival in a new patient cohort.

name: clinical-variable-factor-correlation
description: Use when a fitted MOFA (or DIABLO) model contains discriminant factors separating cohorts and you need to interpret those factors by correlating them with clinical/metadata variables and pathway/literature annotations.

name: clinvar-clinical-significance-classification
description: Use when you need a curated, review-status-filtered ClinVar variant set (two-star variants) with clinical-significance labels to benchmark annotation tools like ANNOVAR, SnpEff, or VEP.

name: clinvar-high-review-status-variant-filtering
description: Use when building a benchmark set from ClinVar for comparing variant-annotation outputs or ACMG rule application and you need only variants with a high (two-star) review status.

name: clinvar-reference-annotation-parsing
description: Use when you need a trusted ClinVar reference set of HGVSc/HGVSp and coding-impact strings (e.g., 164,549 two-star variants) to benchmark HGVS output from annotation tools like ANNOVAR, SnpEff, or VEP.

name: clinvar-variant-classification
description: Use when the analysis goal is to quantify how annotation tool discrepancies in PVS1/PP3 calls translate into ACMG classification changes, requiring implementation of the 2015 ACMG rule engine with the paper's thresholds on ClinVar high-review-status variants.

name: clinvar-variant-concordance-analysis
description: Use when evaluating whether a variant annotation pipeline (ANNOVAR, SnpEff, VEP) produces HGVS nomenclature and coding-impact calls consistent with ClinVar high-review-status (two-star) variants, and when quantifying which mismatch classes (NA, position/variant-type, non-preferred syntax) dominate.

name: cll-ighv-cohort-discriminant-factor-analysis
description: Use when a multi-omics cohort (transcriptomics, methylomics, metabolomics) carries binary condition labels such as mutated vs unmutated IGHV, and the goal is to fine-tune a MOFA model to find and interpret the factors that discriminate the two patient groups.

name: closed-form-acquisition-numerical-validation
description: Use when you must verify that an acquisition-function implementation (EI over a fitted GP surrogate) reproduces the analytic closed-form values before trusting argmax-based gradient or parameter selection.

name: closed-subgraph-closeness-verification
description: Use when frequent fragmentation subtrees have been enumerated from fragmentation graphs of m/z differences and redundant (non-closed) patterns must be filtered before reporting.

name: cls-mean-fusion-pooling-design
description: Use when building or retraining a bi-encoder/cross-encoder hybrid for pairwise 1H NMR spectra classification and you must decide how to aggregate cross-encoder token outputs into a single feature vector for the classifier head.

name: cls-token-pooling-classification-head
description: Use when adapting a pre-trained transformer language model for metabolomics-based disease prediction: you need a pooled sequence representation from a learnable [CLS] token feeding a classification head over metabolite-derived token embeddings.

name: cluster-agreement-statistics-reproduction
description: Use when you have MS-Cluster clusterinfo.tsv clusters for a ProteomeXchange dataset plus a parallel DB-Search purity estimate, and you need to quantify how well MS-RT purity matches a database-search ground truth at the per-cluster level.

name: cluster-center-spectra-export
description: Use when you have a TIC-normalised annotated pixel matrix (image.norm.csv) from a mass spectrometry imaging lipidomics run and need to segment tissue into spectrally similar regions and recover their average lipid profiles.

name: cluster-completeness-entropy-computation
description: Use when comparing spectrum clustering tools (falcon, MS-Cluster, msCRUSH, MaRaCluster, spectra-cluster) and you need a normalized, information-theoretic purity metric per tool at a matched fraction of incorrectly clustered spectra (~1%).

name: cluster-hit-propagation-to-spectra
description: Use when a spectral clustering result (cluster labels plus medoid indexes) exists for unidentified MS/MS spectra and you want to annotate whole clusters by searching only one representative spectrum per cluster and fanning out the hit.

name: cluster-label-mapping-across-tools
description: Use when comparing how different spectrum clustering tools fragment the spectra of a specific peptide (e.g. VATVSIPR/2) — i.e. you have per-spectrum cluster labels from several tools plus identifications and want a per-tool unique-cluster count.

name: cluster-label-table-export
description: Use when you have a tabular feature matrix (e.g. the iris dataset with 150 samples and 4 morphological measurements) and need per-sample cluster membership labels from both a centroid-based (k-means) and a density-based (DBSCAN) method written to a shareable CSV.

name: cluster-membership-matrix-construction
description: Use when you have per-dataset cluster label vectors c_m (M omic datasets, K_m clusters each) and need a single binary matrix encoding cluster memberships as input to COCA consensus clustering.

name: cluster-noise-label-normalization
description: Use when comparing cluster assignments from multiple MS/MS clustering tools whose noise conventions differ — e.g. falcon's '-1' label versus unlabeled singletons — before evaluating cluster purity or cluster size distributions.

name: cluster-number-selection-silhouette
description: Use when an integrative clustering (KLIC on consensus kernels, or COCA on cluster-of-clusters) has been run over multiple candidate K values and the number of clusters must be chosen by maximum average silhouette width.

name: cluster-overlap-statistics-reporting
description: Use when two or more independently processed same-method nontargeted LC-MS datasets have been aligned with Eclipse (clique-based, diameter 1) and the analysis goal is quantifying feature overlap across datasets, e.g. common-to-all counts and fragmented cluster counts.

name: cluster-representative-selection-for-qm-refinement
description: Use when a large RDKit-generated conformer ensemble (hundreds of geometries per protonation state) has been relaxed with ASE-ANI and must be reduced to structurally distinct representatives before DFT-level geometry optimization.

name: cluster-size-cap-sampling
description: Use when a large spectrum collection (e.g. GeMS mined from MassIVE GNPS) contains redundant near-duplicate spectra and you need size-limited representative subsets for training or evaluation.

name: cluster-structure-verification-in-chemodiverse-datasets
description: Use when you have an aligned MS2-fingerprint (MEMO) matrix over a large chemodiverse sample set and must confirm that specific bioactive or otherwise annotated samples occupy the reported positions (co-clusters or singletons) in UMAP/TMAP visualizations.

name: cluster-to-tissue-composition-quantification
description: Use when you have pixel-level MSI clusters (e.g. HDBSCAN clusters within a cell-type mask such as Ly6G+ neutrophils) and registered/segmented tissue-region annotations, and need to quantify the percentage composition of each cluster per tissue compartment.

name: clustercad-pathway-design-sourcing
description: Use when designing or redesigning biosynthetic pathways computationally and you need verified BGC sequence/annotation data of known function as a starting point, or when confirming that a pathway-design tool sources its BGC data from MIBiG.

name: clustered-heatmap-visualization
description: Use when a wide-formatted metabolomics feature table (samples as columns, metabolomics features as rows) needs exploratory co-clustering of samples and features — a hierarchical cluster heatmap with dendrograms plus a pairwise centroid-distance matrix.

name: clustering-accuracy-evaluation-against-cell-phenotypes
description: Use when you have a pretreated SCMS metabolomics feature matrix for cells with known phenotype labels (e.g., primary/metastatic pairs, untreated vs drug-treated) and need to quantify how well unsupervised clustering alone discriminates the phenotypes before building a supervised classifier.

name: clustering-agreement-evaluation-nmi-ari
description: Use when a BGC clustering result (GCF assignments from BiG-SCAPE, BiG-SLiCE, or similar) must be scored against curated MIBiG group labels to compare clustering quality across tools or thresholds.

name: clustering-agreement-metrics-computation
description: Use when you must show that a trained model's intermediate representations progressively discard batch/hospital information while retaining disease-class information, layer by layer.

name: clustering-ari-evaluation
description: Use when comparing integrative or single-dataset clustering results against simulated or known ground-truth labels, e.g. judging whether KLIC's kernel-weighted clustering outperforms COCA, iCluster, or single consensus matrices by ARI.

name: clustering-benchmark-metric-implementation
description: Use when you have cluster info TSVs (filename, scan, mass, rt_time, cluster) from msCluster/Falcon/MaRaCluster and need label-free purity, N10, or percent-clustered metrics to compare clustering tools.

name: clustering-cutoff-parameter-sensitivity-analysis
description: Decision support for choosing a clustering threshold or alignment mode (e.g., BiG-SCAPE 0.30 vs 0.50, global vs glocal) when an independent validation signal such as known metabolite-GCF pairs is available to score each parameter combination.

name: clustering-meaningfulness-benchmarking
description: Use when a quant/feature table plus sample metadata are available and the goal is to test whether chemically informed (hierarchy-based) sample clustering aligns with known sample-type categories better than agnostic ordination metrics.

name: clustering-purity-and-n10-evaluation
description: Use when you have run one or more MS/MS clustering tools (MS-Cluster, Falcon, MaRaCluster) on a metabolomics or proteomics dataset and need to quantify clustering quality in terms of purity and N10 completeness without relying on FDR-controlled identifications.

name: clustering-quality-metric-computation
description: Use when you have cluster labels assigned over millions of MS/MS spectra together with peptide identifications and need to quantify clustered fraction, incorrect clustering, and completeness for tool comparison.

name: clustering-quality-metric-tabulation
description: Decision support for choosing a spectrum clustering tool when you have cluster assignments from multiple tools plus peptide-labeled PSMs (e.g., 1% FDR) and need to compare cluster size distributions, purity, completeness, and data-volume reduction at a comparable error rate.

name: clustering-tool-performance-evaluation
description: Use when comparing the computational efficiency of spectrum clustering tools (falcon, msCRUSH, MS-Cluster, MaRaCluster, spectra-cluster) on the same raw MS/MS dataset, specifically to quantify comparisons per spectrum and runtime at a fixed clustering quality point.

name: cmm-format-annotation-table-processing
description: Use when a CMM-format annotation table from untargeted metabolomics carries multiple putative annotations per feature and must be curated to a smaller, score-ranked entry set for manual inspection or pathway analysis.

name: cnn-architecture-implementation-for-spectra
description: Use when building or reproducing a CNN that classifies compound presence in 1D NMR mixture spectra despite chemical shift variation and peak overlap, and an augmentable spectral dataset with binary labels is available.

name: cnn-based-peak-quality-classification
description: Use when QCing feature tables from LC-MS-based metabolomics runs where automated feature detection produces EICs that may include false positives, and manual peak-by-peak inspection is impractical.

name: cnn-bioactivity-classification
description: Use when you have raw LC-MS/MS data for many biological samples (e.g., 545 wild soybean accessions) plus a binary or binned bioactivity endpoint (DPPH, elastase, TFC, TPC) and want end-to-end activity prediction without compound annotation.

name: cnn-chromatographic-peak-classification
description: Use when raw LC-HRMS profile-mode chromatograms (local maxima in rt x mz space) must be separated into true chromatographic peaks versus irrelevant background signals, and peak-center/bounding-box annotations are needed for downstream feature grouping.

name: cnn-hyperparameter-grid-search
description: Use when training the pSCNN model on augmented NMR mixture spectra and you must determine which epochs, learning rate, and convolutional layer count yield the validation accuracy before final model selection.

name: cnn-image-classification-inference

name: cnn-multi-task-fingerprint-inference

name: cnn-multitask-model-evaluation

name: cnn-training-instance-augmentation

name: cnn-transfer-learning-fine-tuning

name: cnv-rna-correlation-interpretation

name: cobra-model-manipulation

name: cobrapy-model-loading-and-export
